description: A fixed-length vector produced by an embedding model so that texts with similar meaning point in similar directions. Only vectors from the same model and version are comparable.
The length of an embedding vector. Fixed per model (or per truncation setting); an index must hold vectors of one dimension only.
Dot product divided by the product of the vector lengths, from -1 to 1. Equals the dot product for unit vectors.
The k highest-scoring candidates. Vector search always finds k neighbors, relevant or not.
A minimum score below which results are dropped, so a query the corpus cannot answer returns nothing. Calibrated per embedding model.
Applying metadata filters before ranking, so results are always eligible and topK fills up. Post-filtering the top results can leave too few or none.
Approximate nearest neighbor structures such as HNSW (graph) and IVF (clusters) that search millions of vectors fast, trading a little recall for speed.
A database for embeddings with filtered similarity search, such as pgvector, Qdrant, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone or LanceDB.
